title: Is this a PE file?

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

description:
Check the headers at the start of a Windows program.

```
MZ found
e_lfanew = 0xF8
PE\0\0 found at 0xF8
machine 0x8664 (x64), 6 sections, optional header 240 bytes (PE32+)
```
hints: Every read starts with a bounds check: `at + size <= d.size()` (lesson 1.03).
The file header follows the 4-byte signature: machine at +4, section count at +6, optional header size at +20.
requirements: Check `MZ` at 0, read `e_lfanew` (a 32-bit value at 0x3C), check `PE\0\0` there.
Read the machine, number of sections and optional header size from the file header, and the magic (0x20B for PE32+).
Refuse anything that points outside the file.
stretch: Print the entry point and image base from the optional header.
